name: com.imasu.steamworks
description: Reusable Steam multiplayer stack: Steam lobby session, Mirror transport via FizzyFacepunch, distance-based voice, LAN/KCP fallback, and a one-stop configuration window (Imasu Steamworks Control Center). Game-agnostic - add to any Unity 6 project.

samples.description: Copy-paste MonoBehaviours for common Steam UI: avatar badges, lobby code displays, player lists, invite buttons, voice indicators and a host setup form. Import via Package Manager, then drag onto your UI.
